title: Optional Groq and Gemini connections enter validation
summary: Groq and Gemini responded to basic local Mac API calls. The new BATU WORKS cloud model adapter passed six offline checks and independent engineering review; authenticated end-to-end use and function calling through the new entry point remain unverified.

title: Studio delivery and handoff verified
summary: We verified that a fresh collaborator can resume a project from its recorded version, build results and next steps. The studio's delivery process pairs human direction with engineering and independent review, followed by on-device acceptance and a separate release decision.

title: BATU WORKS official website is live
summary: Our public studio website is now available with detailed pages for Element Atlas and Daily Quotes, our development approach, privacy information, and a company updates section. Both apps remain in development and are not yet publicly released.
